purpose: Single targeted A/B for Order 128 generic hypothesis 2: make the model-facing image output-path contract explicit when an instruction supplies only a basename.
change_scope: Retain the reusable image.rearrange_equal_sections implementation and clarify only its generic model-facing output-path semantics: when an instruction gives an output basename without a destination directory, select a path beside input_path instead of defaulting to the process working directory or home. The model still selects and sends the complete output_path unchanged; the Runner and Adapter do not infer, rewrite, or inject it. No Desktop constant, task filename, task ID, dataset order, answer value, golden material, or evaluator state is used.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this single targeted A/B. Do not rerun it unchanged. Classify any remaining failure before editing. At most one additional materially different generic hypothesis remains for Order 128, and stop early when evidence isolates a low-value model-side failure. Never exceed 600 Agent seconds or eight no-progress events in this attempt; when the per-task budget is exhausted, mark task_blocked and immediately continue to Order 129.

implementation_evidence.failure_evidence: The v139 semantic image action executed successfully with the exact model-selected arguments, correctly reordered vertical thirds as [2, 1, 0], and verified pixel preservation. The evaluator still returned 0.0 because Qwen selected /home/user/rearranged.png after the instruction requested only rearranged.png, while the input asset and evaluator output location were /home/user/Desktop. The Agent then repeated the same successful call and stopped under the eight-event no-progress guard.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_tests: Catalog tests use unrelated image names and directories, verify the generic input-parent rule without any Desktop constant, and preserve non-image routing exclusions. Existing image-section tests use different section counts, both axes, semantic and explicit ordering, unrelated paths, and invalid permutations.
implementation_evidence.static_verification: Ruff lint on the complete active source tree and format on changed files, compileall, project layout/deployment leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, frozen OSWorld commit, and evaluator-tree checks passed. The broader active tree contains pre-existing Ruff format drift outside this change.
implementation_evidence.implementation_bundle_algorithm: sha256 of sorted sha256sum lines for the retained implementation and focused-test files
